title: Determining geolocations of composite entities based on heterogeneous data sources

source_provenance.note: Ephemeral request-token parameters are intentionally not persisted.

publicly_described_functional_concepts: associating elementary and composite objects through ontology-defined relationships
retrieving timestamped geolocation observations from heterogeneous data sources
combining constituent-object location observations to infer a composite-object location
using source priority or confidence signals to resolve conflicting observations
storing computed location plus time context for reuse by authorized applications
supporting time-aware geolocation requests against ontology-backed object models
person-location examples in the publication are retained only as patent-scope boundary signals and are not enabled as default building memory

scope_model.analysis_loop: receive authorized asset or aggregate-location request -> resolve permitted ontology relationships -> fetch timestamped source observations -> align time windows -> score source quality/confidence -> derive coarse composite location -> attach uncertainty/provenance -> return only policy-authorized result
building_patterns_relevant_to_independen: treat source reliability and time alignment as explicit fields
keep raw observations separate from derived composite locations
return uncertainty/confidence with every derived location
bind every source traversal to authorization and purpose context
prefer coarse aggregate or asset-level locations over person-linked location inference
make data-source provenance reversible from every derived location
apply retention and freshness rules to cached geospatial conclusions

independent_claim_themes: ontology-based association of elementary objects with moving composite objects
receiving timestamped geolocation datasets from multiple associated data sources
deriving composite-object location and corresponding time identifiers
related distance/alert and changing-membership concepts appear in dependent claim themes
claim_scope_signals.legal_scope_rule: Patent scope depends on controlling claims, prosecution history, legal status, and jurisdiction. This record is an engineering research abstraction only.

use_for: authorized fleet or equipment location aggregation

mandatory_safety_boundaries: no covert or cross-dataset person tracking
